question.text: The most preferred constitutional structure for an AIF in India is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Almost all AIFs formed in India follow the trust structure due to operational advantages, favorable regulatory framework, tax efficiency, reduced compliance costs, and flexibility to form its own governance and reporting system. The Trap: While LLP is popular internationally (GP/LP structure), in India the trust structure dominates. Company structure is least preferred due to tax inefficiency.
